# P36.8 — Statutory disclosures I: ALPR regimes (10) + connector generalization (R11-ACQ-12)

**Requirement ids:** **SIG-INGEST-027/028** (each of the ten rows carries `compact_status`/`custody_posture`/`ingestion_permitted=false`; the loader gate refuses all ten until the operator's flip) · **SIG-ONTO-052a** (every `[technology_map]` value and adapter-declared slug resolves against the generated `ontology/vocab/technology.yaml` registry — enforced in `sig-connectors validate`) · **SIG-ONTO-021** (an unmapped technology literal mints NO claim — recorded on the artifact, never a guessed slug) · **P8-2** (upstream documents are captured as evidence artifacts and never re-hosted — claims carry derived facts + the upstream link; the committed fixtures are synthetic reconstructions of the reviewed surfaces) · **§43.4** (officer/person names are never extracted — Part VIII aggregate schema + forbidden-column/token guards bind every new row) · **procured ≠ deployed** (`disclosure_use` rides only filings that themselves report use — `reports_use` declarations or `reports_use_pattern` literals; registration lists are `inventory_entry` assertions, never verified deployments — the WA AGO says it did not verify the entries, I9a-C036) · **§26** (crawler conduct — bounded `doc_url_contains`/`doc_suffixes`/same-host fan-out; the MD DLS + VA RGA catalogues' `scope_terms` screen admits surveillance-relevant deposits only) · **SIG-GEO-003** (MN BCA published location strings stay verbatim literals — never geocoded; a new geometry lineage needs its own review).

**Ticket:** `docs/tickets/281_P36.8__statutory-disclosures-alpr-regimes.md` (manifest row 281) · **Base:** `r11/P36.7-procurement-and-programme-registers` (`ede00b2e`) · **Branch:** `r11/P36.8-statutory-disclosures-alpr-regimes` · **OM-20 posture:** none — committed registry/target/cadence rows, connector/vocab config, fixtures and tests only; no deploy, no fetch, no `ingestion_permitted` flip, no gate ticked. Live legs: none (the wave-activation row owns them).

## Why

Wave-B batch `r11-disclosures-01` (`27 7 21 * *`, create-paused) registers the ten statutory ALPR-regime disclosures I8 §5.5 re-routed onto `government_mandated_disclosure` (I7 had proposed `dossier_documents`; I8's design carries three reasons the disclosure connector's claim types and index→document adapters are the statutory-reporting model). The connector generalizes beyond its municipal-CCOPS origins: state and federal publishers in `[sources]` under `iso.3166_2` jurisdictions, a reviewed `statutory_report` fallback genre, a technology-literal→SKOS map on PKG-07's slug set, and one `[adapters.<publisher>]` spec per publisher — all config-driven, all CCOPS fixtures diff 0.

## What ships

- **Connector generalization** (`government_mandated_disclosure.py`, +578): `technology_map()` + `technology_map_violations()` (map values and adapter-declared slugs must be ACTIVE `technology.yaml` members — wired into `sig-connectors validate`); `_declared_genre()` — the reviewed `document_genre` fallback applies ONLY where the capture's text classifies to no genre (a text-derived genre always stands); `_mapped_technologies()` (unmapped literals recorded on the artifact as `unmapped_technology_literals`, never guessed); `_index_entries()`/`_extract_statutory_entries()` — page-carried `agency` rows emit `inventory_entry` `approval_status` assertions (plus a typed `technology` claim only where the row's own literal maps) and `location` rows emit verbatim `deployment_location` use claims keyed to the preceding agency heading, only where the filing reports use; `field_patterns`/`use_fields` (use predicates only, value-pinning supported); `agency_anchor_pattern` + `agency_field_pattern` (per-filing agency from the link anchor or the form's own field — never the publisher name); `scope_terms` admission screen for broad deposit catalogues; `document_entries` (the entries mechanism over a filing's own bytes — VT DPS); `reports_use`/`reports_use_pattern` (the filing's own use statement); plaintext-extract document handling (`text_layer = "plaintext_extract"` for committed text extracts of >1 MB upstream filings); statutory reporting-period derivation (`UPDATED:`, `Date:`, filename fragments, covered years); Part VIII suppressions recorded on the artifact.
- **`DocumentGenre.STATUTORY_REPORT`** (`parsing/genre.py`): deliberately absent from the classifier's marker table — statutory filings share vocabulary with policy/deployment documents, so the classifier never guesses it; `genre_claim_types` gains it (`ordinance`, `inventory_entry`, `disclosure`, `disclosure_use` — no `compliance_finding`; `disclosure_use` still requires the deployment genre or `reports_actual_use`).
- **Vocab** (`government_mandated_disclosure_vocab.toml`, `vocab_version 2026.10.12` with the migration note): the ten `[sources]` keys, the 60-literal `[technology_map]` (ALPR variants → `alpr-*`, plus FRT/ShotSpotter/CSS/BWC/ATE/UAS/CCTV/RTCC for the catalogue publishers), and the ten reviewed `[adapters.<publisher>]` specs.
- **Ten gated sources wired:** `sources.toml` (the ACQ-01 generated rows renamed in place to the I8 §5.5 design ids — `statrep_wa_ago_alpr_registry`, `statrep_mn_bca`, `statrep_va_vsp_alpr`, `statrep_va_vscc_alpr`, `statrep_ne_crime_commission_alpr`, `statrep_vt_dps_alpr`, `statrep_il_isp_alpr`, `statrep_austin_tx_auditor`, `statrep_md_dls_mandated_reports`, `statrep_va_rga`; notes record the reconciliation; all `ingestion_permitted=false`, RB-03 basis, rights UNDETERMINED, `iso.3166_2` jurisdictions); `runner.py` `CONNECTOR_FOR_SOURCE`; `live_targets.toml` (six `index_page`, four `disclosure_document` targets — `statrep_mn_bca` carries only the `lpr_agency_list` seat; the I4-C005 UAV reports are P36.9a's); `live_dispositions.toml` (the ten `promote` placeholders resolved — a connector-mapped source carries no disposition row); `ops/cadence.toml` `r11-disclosures-01` (10 members, paused).
- **Fixtures + tests:** `tests/connectors/fixtures/statrep/` — synthetic reconstructions of the reviewed surfaces with `SOURCES.md` provenance (index pages exercising scope/same-host/path fan-out; plaintext filing extracts exercising field/use literals, anchor-derived agency, mandated field states). `tests/connectors/test_statrep_p36_8.py` (49 tests): registration/routing/gating, live-target kinds, cadence membership, slug-map ontology membership + fail-closed validation, declared-genre fallback precedence, per-publisher claim shapes (registration-vs-use, verbatim locations, anchor agency, scope screen, field states, value pinning), the statutory use-claim guard, per-source +0 shadow replay, and the Part VIII aggregate gate on every emitted row.
